blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — An unidentified man died after jumping from the Bued Bridge in Sison town and falling about 100 meters onto the rocky riverbed on Friday afternoon, Nov. 13. Mercedes Esmeralda, 49, a resident of Barangay Dungon in Sison, told investigators that she saw the man climb onto the bridge’s concrete railing along the southbound lane and balance himself before suddenly jumping. The bridge connects Pangasinan and La Union provinces.
